title: •Special Delivery
caption: •Special Delivery (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, if Carbonite Chamber Console on table, may use 1 Force to ▼ an Effect. If opponent’s just lost character is about to be removed from Lost Pile, may lose 1 Force to capture (imprison or let escape) that character instead. {alter}
lore: Because bounty hunters are untrustworthy, the Empire relies on its troopers for efficient prisoner delivery.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. The slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. The wiki's default 'Special Delivery' page is the printed archive face; 'Special Delivery (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set) used as base_page. CC-D-specialdelivery.gif (349 px) is the PC errata face (text '‘delivers’ (imprisons)…', 'E' tag) — downloaded to src/vs6/45-CC-D-specialdelivery.gif for art only; the printed face is the 367×506 decipher-archive scan used as src (a slightly skewed photo-style scan, so the art crop may need attention). Lore matches the scan. Copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2-D-specialdelivery-pre.gif, 350 px; non-pre also exists; the VB8 'Den Of Thieves & Special Delivery' image is a different combo card).
